entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: The applicant has filed this First application u/S 439, Cr.P.C. for grant of bail.
The applicant has been arrested by Police Station Chanchoda, District Guna in connection with crime No. 411/2021 registered for t h e offence punishable under Section 420 of IPC.

Allegations against the applicant/accused, in short, are that he along with other co-accused persons were involved in getting money from the ATM by deceiving the victims and utilizing their ATM cards.
Learned counsel for the applicant argued that applicant is an innocent person and has been falsely implicated.
He further argued that applicant is the only earning member of his family.
He further argued that applicant has been arrayed in the present case as an accused only on account of his own memorandum, but pursuance to his memorandum nothing has been seized from him.

sentences.text: applicant has been arrested by Maharashtra Police and thereafter in the present case he has been made accused, however, there is no evidence to connect him with the present crime.
The applicant is in custody since 24/11/2022.
Charge sheet has since been filed and further custodial interrogation of the applicant may not be required.
The applicant is permanent resident of District Hisar (Haryana).
Conclusion of trial is likely to take time and there is no likelihood of his absconsion, if released on bail.
On these grounds, he prays for grant of bail to the applicant.
On the other hand, learned State counsel vehemently opposed the application on the ground of criminal antecedents of the applicant and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.
Certified copy as per rules.
